summary: Range Capital Acquisition Corp., a SPAC, filed a Form 8-K to modify the terms of a proposed extension to its business combination deadline. The company will ask shareholders to approve an amendment at an extraordinary general meeting on June 18, 2026, to extend the deadline from 18 months after its December 2024 IPO to up to 27 months, in monthly increments. For each one-month extension, the sponsor will deposit $0.03 per outstanding public share (max $60,000) into the trust account in exchange for an unsecured promissory note. The filing supplements the definitive proxy statement filed May 5, 2026. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and potential redemption pressure.
